correctness.rationale: Fresh-label omitted slots define contiguous lifespans. Greedy minimum interval covering ends at independent complete k-slot coupon epochs. A many-to-one map from fresh formal labels to actual recurring labels proves pathwise T_n>=T*. The probability of first label recurrence at exchange j is <=(j-1)/(n-k), yielding the stated factorial-moment TV bound. A fixed block of sk prescribed slot selections with fresh identities has probability >=(2k)^(-sk) for all sufficiently large n and supplies the residual mean bound. Geometric waiting-time moments and the classical coupon-collector Gumbel theorem complete the statements; 11400 exhaustive ideal instances and 144000 finite checks replay.
